text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff Tachyon... really is fast.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... Cough!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine... Sorry for making you worry. It
looks
like... I've reached my limit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I have no doubt... She was there... ahead
of
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Tachyon is the closest to my
friend. I
have no choice... but to go after
her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my contest with her... my
guidepost...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown tour and
Manhattan Cafe's goal to chase after her
friend align perfectly. If she can keep on
chasing after Agnes Tachyon into the
future...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, heh heh heh! Now I see, Cafe! This is who you are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is good! This is good! You've got no chance, but it's good! The failure I anticipated is at odds with unforeseen success!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And rightly so. The world runs on the
process of
elimination, you know.
Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon gleefully laughs to
herself for a
little while, then looks to
the sky and whispers
something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tachyons—the hypothetical particles
believed to
move faster than light.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But even if they are hypothetical, I
should make a
demonstration ...of the
afterimage borne of
madness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho. I have no doubt that
glittering
embers will emerge once the
inferno abates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to chase after Tachyon, I
think my
next race should be the Satsuki
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we would go straight for
the Triple
Crown tour, but I should step
back and think this
through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon seemed fearless this
afternoon.
And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... Cough! Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Y-yes... A little...
choice_data_list: Didn't today's race take a toll on...
Didn't today's race take a lot out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's race has taken its toll on her
frail
constitution. Even if our goal is clear
now, setting our sights on a G1 race
anytime soon is out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What about... the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might be onto something. The
Japanese
Derby is a race I'd like to see
Manhattan Cafe
win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we made that our goal, we'd have
to take
a pretty high-stakes gamble on
whether we could
pull it off...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. All I do is mess up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I shouldn't be taking advantage... of your kindness... Not at a time like this. Cough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's calm down for a moment and think
about
this. If we're going for steady
success...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In the fall... The preliminary to the
Kikuka Sho...
That's so far away...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the St. Lite Kinen i...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But we should... at least try the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My condition...
choice_data_list: Let's see how things go before we ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Okay. But if I can recover in time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, the St. Lite Kinen is our goal,
and we'll enter the Japanese Derby if we
can. As her
trainer, this is the best road
map I can offer.
